units.label: Comparison
units.title: Compare one question at a time
units.question: What becomes easier to see when cases are compared one dimension at a time?
units.cognitiveJob: Establish the non-equivalence warning and the cross-case findings, then choose one controlled dimension or the complete scholarly comparison. The overview never asks the reader to integrate the full matrix.

sources.note: Warning and high-level findings authored for the guided layer in #45.

caveats: The eight cases are compared, never ranked. No view reachable from here orders them by severity, gravity or death toll.

units.label: Dimension: tempo
units.title: Dimension: tempo
units.question: How does the duration of violence change the organizational problem a case presents?
units.cognitiveJob: One job: hold duration stable across all eight cases and read what that single variable does and does not reveal.

sources.note: Display period and classification per case from cases.json.

caveats: Duration describes an organizational problem, not a degree of gravity. A shorter case is not a lesser one.
units.note: Tempo is the #45 prototype dimension, not one of the five issue-defined rollout themes (preconditions and structural catalysts; target construction and propaganda; transitional mechanisms; cruelty and modality; perpetrator selection). Whether it survives as a drill-down, becomes an overview example, or folds into another view is a #47 decision and is not settled here. Rendered as a section of its parent surface rather than as its own route (#58). The unit keeps its identity, its question, its cognitive job and its caveats — it is still one job, still separately addressable, and still the thing resume names. What it no longer costs the reader is a page load and a back button to reach the next unit of the same case.

units.label: Scholarly depth
units.title: The complete comparison
units.question: What does the comparison contain when every case and dimension is on one surface?
units.cognitiveJob: One job: inspect the complete comparison — the duration figure, the full matrix and the comparative-analysis manuscript — as research material rather than as a phone reading path.
caveats: This is a research surface, not a summary. No figure on it encodes a death toll as geometry, and the matrix does not resolve the uncertainty its cells carry.
